channel.title: SpatialX Insights
channel.description: Insights on geospatial architecture, modernization, spatial data engineering, security, reliability, and location intelligence.

item.title: Bad Spatial Data Is an Architecture Problem
item.description: Messy geometry, weak metadata, unclear ownership, and broken pipelines are often architecture problems—not just data-cleanup problems.

item.title: When GIS Becomes Critical Infrastructure
item.description: Why enterprise GIS should be treated as operational infrastructure when organizations depend on it for planning, reporting, service delivery, and decisions.

item.title: The Difference Between GIS Support and GIS Architecture
item.description: GIS support fixes immediate issues. GIS architecture reduces recurring problems by improving platform, data, security, integration, and operational design.

item.title: Secure by Design: What It Means for Geospatial Systems
item.description: Secure geospatial architecture includes identity, data exposure, roles, service boundaries, resilience, governance, and operational trust.

item.title: What’s So Spatial About a Service Outage?
item.description: A GIS service outage can disrupt reporting, operations, delivery, and trust. Learn why reliability is an architectural concern, not just a server issue.

item.title: What’s So Spatial About Risk?
item.description: Risk is spatial: it clusters, follows networks, changes with proximity, and becomes more useful when geography is part of the decision model.
